title: Pink Flamingo Office Halloween Costume
intro: A Halloween costume you can wear to work without a single raised eyebrow from HR. A flowy pink midi dress, a pink feather fascinator, satin Mary Jane flats, opaque pink tights, a little bow top handle bag and flamingo glitter earrings. From a distance it is a very good pink outfit. Up close, the feathers and the earrings give the joke away. Take the fascinator off at five and nobody would ever know it was a costume, and almost every piece stays in the closet well past October.
